name: orphograph
description: Anchor a file's fingerprint to the Bitcoin chain via Orphograph. The file never leaves the device — only the SHA-256 fingerprint crosses the wire.
long_description: A single-file, stdlib-only Model Context Protocol server that lets any MCP host anchor files to the Bitcoin chain via Orphograph (https://orphograph.com). The file body never leaves the user's machine: the server hashes locally and transmits only the SHA-256/SHA-512 fingerprints. Receipts are verifiable independently of Orphograph via OpenTimestamps. Tools: anchor a file, verify a receipt, list the subscriber vault. A receipt proves a file existed in exactly this form by a recorded date; it does not prove authorship, ownership, or that the file's contents are true.

ORPHO_API_KEY.title: Orphograph API key
ORPHO_API_KEY.description: Optional API key from https://orphograph.com/account.html. Without it, anchors use the free tier (three anchors per 24h per IP).
